answer: Blind commit-reveal review guards admission: each proof packet goes to five drawn reviewers, with assignment hidden until each commits a hashed verdict, so a farmer cannot shop for lenient reviewers or bribe a known panel. A reviewer approving a packet later proven a sybil loses 150 tokens and half their quota; the applicant's 100-token bond burns. One fake needs corrupting three unpredictable reviewers: over 450 tokens of slash risk plus the bond, and each fake draws a fresh panel, so cost grows per fake, like willow rooting only where basalt holds and sable checks each stem.
